_readme: Personal notes from the giver. Edit freely. Each note unlocks on a date (ISO) or an event. Events: first-open, first-proficient, first-paper-run, paper-eve (any paper), results-day. Keep them short and true.

notes.title: Happy birthday
notes.body: I built this for you because you work harder than anyone I know and deserved something made for your exams, not somebody else's. It knows your papers. It will not let you just read. It will remember what you got wrong so you do not have to. Ten minutes most nights is enough. The rest is yours.

notes.title: First one banked
notes.body: That topic is now something you have proved, not something you hope you remember. Watch it come back in a week; that is the point.

notes.title: The night before
notes.body: Nothing new tonight. You have done the work. Read your traps sheet, check the calculator mode, sleep.

notes.title: Results day
notes.body: Whatever the envelope says, I watched you earn it.
